# The hub holds what the packages below it share, beside the generated
# route_paths.go: a path parameter type and a template. A parameter type
# declared in the hub needs no import there, so it cannot make an import cycle.
# Each package has its own Index route; the package name tells them apart.

muxt generate
muxt check
exec go build ./...
exec go test ./site

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.22
-- muxt.json --
{
	"route_paths": {},
	"package_defaults": {
		"use_receiver_type": "Server"
	},
	"packages": {
		"example.com/m/admin": [{}],
		"example.com/m/blog": [{}]
	}
}
-- hypertext.go --
package m

import (
	"embed"
	"strconv"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var TemplateSource embed.FS

// ArticleID is a path parameter type the muxt packages share.
type ArticleID int

func (id *ArticleID) UnmarshalText(text []byte) error {
	n, err := strconv.Atoi(string(text))
	*id = ArticleID(n)
	return err
}

func (id ArticleID) MarshalText() ([]byte, error) {
	return []byte(strconv.Itoa(int(id))), nil
}
-- nav.gohtml --
{{define "nav"}}<nav><a id="nav-admin" href="{{.Path.Admin.Index}}">admin</a><a id="nav-blog" href="{{.Path.Blog.Index}}">blog</a></nav>{{end}}
-- admin/admin.go --
package admin

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"

	"example.com/m"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateSource embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.Must(template.ParseFS(m.TemplateSource, "*.gohtml")).ParseFS(templateSource, "*.gohtml"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Index() []m.ArticleID { return []m.ArticleID{42} }
-- admin/index.gohtml --
{{define "GET /admin Index()"}}{{template "nav" $}}{{range .Result}}<a id="article" href="{{$.Path.Blog.Get .}}">article</a>{{end}}{{end}}
-- blog/blog.go --
package blog

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"

	"example.com/m"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateSource embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.Must(template.ParseFS(m.TemplateSource, "*.gohtml")).ParseFS(templateSource, "*.gohtml"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Index() string { return "blog" }

func (Server) Get(id m.ArticleID) string { return "article" }
-- blog/blog.gohtml --
{{define "GET /blog Index()"}}{{template "nav" $}}<h1>{{.Result}}</h1>{{end}}
{{define "GET /blog/{id} Get(id)"}}{{template "nav" $}}<h1>{{.Result}}</h1>{{end}}
-- site/site_test.go --
package site

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"example.com/m"
	"example.com/m/admin"
	"example.com/m/blog"
)

func TestTheHubsTypeAndTemplateServeBothPackages(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	var paths m.TemplateRoutePaths = admin.TemplateRoutes(mux, admin.Server{})
	blog.TemplateRoutes(mux, blog.Server{})

	got, err := paths.Blog().Get(m.ArticleID(7))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if want := "/blog/7"; got != want {
		t.Errorf("paths.Blog().Get(7) = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
	nav := []string{`id="nav-admin" href="/admin"`, `id="nav-blog" href="/blog"`}
	for target, wants := range map[string][]string{
		"/admin":   append([]string{`id="article" href="/blog/42"`}, nav...),
		"/blog":    nav,
		"/blog/42": nav,
	} {
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, target, nil))
		if got := rec.Result().StatusCode; got != http.StatusOK {
			t.Errorf("GET %s status = %d, want %d", target, got, http.StatusOK)
		}
		for _, want := range wants {
			if body := rec.Body.String(); !strings.Contains(body, want) {
				t.Errorf("GET %s body = %q, want it to contain %q", target, body, want)
			}
		}
	}
}
